label: Form start time
notes: Recorded automatically by the form app.

label: Form end time
notes: Recorded automatically by the form app.

label: Form version
notes: Must change whenever the form changes (PRD 6: no mid-campaign change without versioning).

label: Survey date
notes: Recorded automatically.

label: Observer initials
form_hint: Your initials, same every time.
notes: Operational field. Initials only, no personal data.

label: Site ID
form_hint: Primary LAG-FI-001..120, reserve LAG-FI-R001..R030, pilot LAG-FI-P01..P20. Never reuse an ID.
measurement_rule: Assign before departure. One ID = one road segment + its drainage environment. Never reuse an ID, even if a site is abandoned.
notes: Pilot ID series (LAG-FI-Pnn) is a PROPOSAL: the PRD and tracker do not define pilot IDs. Needs owner decision.

label: Site type
notes: Derived from the ID prefix.

label: Stratum
allowed_values: S1=S1 Low elevation / coastal influence|S2=S2 Inland low-lying urban|S3=S3 Highly built-up / impervious urban|S4=S4 Moderate-density inland / peri-urban|S5=S5 Historically or independently identified flood-exposed|S6=S6 Lower-exposure / comparison|PILOT=Pilot site (no stratum assigned yet)
form_hint: Copy from the sampling frame. Pilot sites: PILOT.
notes: PILOT value is a PROPOSAL because the sampling frame is built after the pilot (PRD 29).

label: Replaces which primary site? (reserve only)
form_hint: Only for a reserve site used as a replacement. Must be in the same stratum.
notes: Validator requires this for every reserve site.

label: Why was the primary site replaced?
allowed_values: inaccessible=Inaccessible|unsafe=Unsafe|not_a_valid_site=Not a valid road/drain site|access_denied=Access denied (private property)|other=Other (explain in notes)
notes: Reason list is a PROPOSAL (PRD 5 only says the reason must be logged).

label: Site location (GPS)
form_hint: Stand at the centre of the segment. Wait until accuracy is good before saving.
measurement_rule: Record at the segment centre point. Same device and settings for the whole campaign. Latitude, longitude and accuracy are split out automatically.
notes: Form-only field. The three calculated fields below are what goes in the analysis table.

label: Latitude (WGS84)
notes: CRS EPSG:4326. Hard limits are a rough sanity box around Lagos, NOT the study boundary. Replace with a boundary check once the study boundary exists (PRD 18).

label: Longitude (WGS84)
notes: CRS EPSG:4326. Hard limits are a rough sanity box around Lagos, NOT the study boundary.

label: GPS accuracy
notes: Soft limit 15 m is a PROPOSAL for flagging poor accuracy (PRD 18 says flag, gives no number).

label: LGA
notes: 20 LGAs listed from general knowledge. Check against the official boundary layer during the dataset audit; the validator can later re-derive LGA from coordinates.

label: Road name or nearest recognisable reference
form_hint: Road name, or a landmark. No private house numbers or names of people.

label: Site access notes
form_hint: How to reach the site; any access problem.

label: Observation segment length
form_hint: Default 50 m, centred on the GPS point. Change only if the site physically cannot give 50 m; say why in notes.
measurement_rule: The segment along the road, centred on the GPS point, inside which potholes are counted and all road and drain conditions are assessed.
notes: PRD 6.2 says 'a defined observation segment' but gives no length. 50 m is a PROPOSAL to confirm or change before the pilot.

label: Pavement type
measurement_rule: Dominant surface within the segment. If mixed, choose the surface under most of the carriageway and describe the rest in notes.

label: Road width (carriageway)
form_hint: Edge to edge of the paved/driven surface, at a representative point.
measurement_rule: Measure across the carriageway at a representative point in the segment. Use the tape or laser from the roadside. Do not stand in the traffic lane. Record the method.

label: How was road width measured?
notes: Validator requires this whenever road_width_m has a value.

label: Pothole count
form_hint: Count visible potholes inside the observation segment.
measurement_rule: Count every visible pothole on the carriageway inside the segment. Count only what you can see safely from the roadside.

label: Largest pothole: length
measurement_rule: Choose the largest pothole you can measure safely. Do not enter the traffic lane. If it cannot be measured safely, use the missing code refused_unsafe.

label: Largest pothole: depth
measurement_rule: Deepest point below the surrounding pavement surface.

label: Cracking
form_hint: 0 none | 1 isolated hairline | 2 several, some linked | 3 widespread or loose pieces
measurement_rule: DRAFT anchors. 0 none visible. 1 minor: isolated or hairline cracks, not linked together. 2 moderate: several cracks, some linked, edges open but no loose pieces. 3 severe: widespread linked (map or alligator) cracking, or loose, displaced or missing surface pieces. Photograph the worst area.
notes: PRD gives only none/minor/moderate/severe. Anchors are project drafts, not from a published standard; test in the pilot.

label: Rutting / deformation
form_hint: 0 none | 1 slight | 2 clear, water would pond | 3 deep or shoving
measurement_rule: DRAFT anchors. 0 none. 1 minor: slight wheel-path depression, visible by eye only. 2 moderate: clear depression or deformation where water would likely pond. 3 severe: deep ruts, shoving or heave that affects vehicle movement. On unpaved roads rate the running surface.

label: Edge failure / erosion of the pavement edge
form_hint: 0 none | 1 slight breaking | 2 broken/eroded part of segment | 3 collapsed/undercut
measurement_rule: DRAFT anchors. 0 none. 1 minor: slight edge breaking or raveling. 2 moderate: broken or eroded edge along part of the segment. 3 severe: edge collapsed or undercut, base exposed, or a large part of the carriageway edge lost.
notes: PRD 6.2 lists 'Edge failure/erosion'. Named edge_failure_score to keep it separate from erosion_score (PRD 6.4 and 11). Owner to confirm these are two different variables.

label: Which drain did you assess?
allowed_values: right=Right-hand side (facing direction of travel)|left=Left-hand side|none=No drain present
form_hint: Stand at the segment centre facing the direction of travel. Use the right-hand drain. Use left only if there is no right-hand drain. 'none' hides all drain questions.
measurement_rule: Fixed rule so drain choice never depends on which drain looks worse: right-hand drain first, left-hand only if none on the right. If there is no drain at all, choose none and the drain questions are skipped.
notes: Operational field, not an analysis variable. The fixed-side rule and the 'none' gate are PROPOSALS; PRD 6.3 does not say how to pick between two drains or what to do when there is none.

label: Drain clear internal width
measurement_rule: Clear internal width at a representative accessible point, measured from outside with tape or laser. Never enter the drain.

label: Drain depth (invert to top edge)
measurement_rule: Invert (bottom) to top edge. Measure from outside with a tape on a rod or a laser. If debris or water hides the invert, record the depth to the visible surface and use notes. If it cannot be measured safely, use refused_unsafe.

label: Obstruction (all materials together)
form_hint: Share of the drain cross-section blocked by everything together, at the worst accessible point.
measurement_rule: Classes are from PRD 6.3. Judge the share of the cross-section blocked by ALL materials together (sediment, vegetation, waste, collapse) at the worst accessible point. On an exact class boundary choose the higher class (DRAFT rule).
notes: Should never be lower than the share for any single material below.

label: Sediment
form_hint: Share of cross-section filled by silt/soil: 1 up to 25% | 2 25-50% | 3 over 50%
measurement_rule: DRAFT anchors. Share of the drain cross-section filled by sediment at the worst accessible point. 0 none. 1 minor: up to 25%. 2 moderate: over 25% to 50%. 3 severe: over 50%.
notes: PRD gives only none/minor/moderate/severe. Numeric anchors are project drafts for repeatability; test in the pilot.

label: Vegetation
form_hint: Share of cross-section filled by plants: 1 up to 25% | 2 25-50% | 3 over 50%
measurement_rule: DRAFT anchors. Same scale as sediment, for plant growth inside the drain. 0 none. 1 up to 25%. 2 over 25% to 50%. 3 over 50%.

label: Solid waste
form_hint: Share of cross-section filled by waste: 1 up to 25% | 2 25-50% | 3 over 50%
measurement_rule: DRAFT anchors. Same scale as sediment, for solid waste inside the drain. 0 none. 1 up to 25%. 2 over 25% to 50%. 3 over 50%.

label: Structural condition
allowed_values: 0=0 Sound|1=1 Minor damage|2=2 Moderate damage|3=3 Severe or failed
form_hint: 0 sound | 1 minor damage | 2 spalling/broken parts, still works | 3 collapsed/failed
measurement_rule: DRAFT anchors. 0 sound: no visible defects. 1 minor damage: hairline cracks, small chips, slight settlement. 2 moderate damage: spalling, broken or missing cover slabs or lining sections, leaning or sagging, drain still works. 3 severe/failed: collapsed, long missing sections, or not working.

label: Visible flow
form_hint: Look from outside. NEVER enter flowing water.
measurement_rule: Observed from outside at the time of the visit. none: no movement. slow: barely visible movement. moderate: clearly moving. fast: turbulent or rapid. Never enter flowing water.

label: Outlet connectivity
measurement_rule: connected_outlet: you can see the drain continuing to an outlet, channel, culvert or another drain. disconnected: the drain visibly ends, is blocked or is buried at its outlet. uncertain: you cannot tell.

label: Standing water present at visit
measurement_rule: 1 if water is lying on the carriageway or shoulder, or standing in the drain, at the time of the visit. Do not enter water to check.
notes: Listed in both PRD 6.2 and 6.4. Recorded once here.

label: Approximate standing water depth
form_hint: Only if safe. Measure from the edge with a rod. Otherwise choose refused_unsafe.
measurement_rule: Only when safe. Never wade into water of unknown depth. Use the missing code refused_unsafe if you cannot measure it safely.

label: Visible prior water mark
measurement_rule: 1 if you can see a stain or line on walls, poles, kerbs, fences or ground consistent with earlier water level. Physical evidence only. Photograph it.

label: Sediment / debris line
measurement_rule: 1 if there is a line of silt, debris or waste left on the road, walls or plants consistent with earlier water.

label: Drain overtopping evidence
measurement_rule: 1 only with physical evidence, for example silt or debris deposited outside the drain edge, flattened plants, or scour channels leading away from the drain. Do not infer from reputation or from what people say.

label: Flood-related erosion (ground beside road/drain)
form_hint: Scour/gullies on shoulder, bank or ground beside road/drain
measurement_rule: DRAFT anchors. Erosion of the shoulder, embankment or ground beside the road or drain. 0 none. 1 minor: surface scour. 2 moderate: gullies or cut channels. 3 severe: deep gullies, undermined edges or large washout. Not the same as edge_failure_score, which is damage to the pavement edge itself.
notes: Owner to confirm the split between erosion_score and edge_failure_score.

label: Pavement water damage
form_hint: Pavement damage that looks water-related
measurement_rule: DRAFT anchors. Damage that looks caused by water action. 0 none. 1 minor: staining or light surface scouring. 2 moderate: loose aggregate, washed-out patches, water-related breaking. 3 severe: washed-out sections, exposed base, undermined slabs. Record what you see. If unsure of the cause, record the damage and say so in notes.

label: Local flood history (reported, optional)
form_hint: OPTIONAL. Leave blank unless the consent step in the protocol has been agreed.
measurement_rule: Contextual report only. Never mix with direct observations. Do not record names. Needs the consent step in the protocol before use.
notes: Allowed values are a PROPOSAL (PRD 6.4 says 'categorical' without values). PRD 20 requires a consent process for local reports. Recommend leaving blank in the pilot.

label: Source of the local flood history report
allowed_values: resident=Resident|business=Shop or business|official=Official sign or record|other=Other
form_hint: Only if local_flood_history was filled. No names.

label: Marker photo taken first (paper card with Site ID)?
form_hint: Photograph a paper card with the Site ID BEFORE the other photos. It tells us which photos belong to this site.
measurement_rule: Take photos with the normal iPhone Camera app, in this order: 0 marker card (paper with the Site ID written large), 1 road approach, 2 pavement surface, 3 drainage entrance, 4 drainage interior, 5 drainage outlet or connection, 6 surrounding terrain and land cover, 7 any visible flood damage or evidence. Safe position only. No faces, no number plates.
notes: Photos are NOT uploaded through the form (iPhone web-form photo upload is unreliable). They are matched to the site later by script using the marker photo and photo timestamps. Design change from the first draft; PRD 7 requires photos linked in the metadata table, which the script does.

label: Number of photos taken at this site (including the marker card)
form_hint: Normal set is 8: marker card plus 7 photos.
measurement_rule: Count all photos you took at this site in the Camera app, marker card included. A normal full set is 8.
notes: Soft minimum 8 = marker plus the 7 PRD photos. Fewer than 8 needs an explanation in photo_exceptions.

label: Which of the 7 photos are missing, and why?
form_hint: Example: 'photo 4 and 5: drain covered, could not see inside'. Needed if fewer than 8 photos.
notes: PRD 26: every valid site has photographic evidence or a documented exception. The validator warns when photo_count is below 8 and this is blank.

label: Photo set ID
notes: Equals site_id (PRD 11). Photo files are copied to SITEID_00.jpg (marker card), SITEID_01.jpg ... by src/data_ingest.py, matched by photo and form timestamps.

label: Notes (context only)
form_hint: Context only. Do not put measurements here. No names or private details.
